name: Pin revisions and division of labour
what_to_do: Record repository revisions used. EDF answers 'What is happening?' (diagnosis of an observed outcome); Clarity answers 'What is justified, and what would make us reconsider?' and evaluates decisions after diagnosis.
notes: Local clones are shallow single-commit; the 2026-11-14 application guide pinned older commits (Clarity 8cd48019, EDF 41fea6f) that are not present locally, so differences cannot be diffed here.

name: Admissibility screen (lint)
what_to_do: Reject (quarantine, not delete) any assumption statement or supporting note that contains: emotion without causal mechanism; prescription without a signal; moral/character framing; unbounded always/never; motivation substituted for incentives; stories without preserved decision forks; cleverness without reuse; premature synthesis/framework language; hidden prescriptions or comfort-optimised phrasing; self-justification; false precision or tidy-but-unearned models; teaching voice/persuasion; hero narratives.

name: Foundational commitments check
what_to_do: Check the claim against: Mechanism First (explain why it works); Signals Before Moves (action needs an entry condition); Incentives Over Intent; Bounded Truth (state edges/counterexamples); Tradeoffs Are Mandatory; Systems Over Heroes.

name: Operational test
what_to_do: Ask: 'Can this idea survive incentives, time, and pressure?' If it only works with good actors, calm conditions or perfect information, it fails.

name: Select assessment effort level (Progressive Commitment)
what_to_do: Choose the smallest assessment sufficient for the risk: Level 0 mental check; Level 1 quick (claim, evidence, assumptions, confidence, one trigger, action); Level 2 full (adds posture, owner, signal, threshold, trigger claim, response, trigger reassessment, correctability); Level 3 formal for high-consequence, low-correctability, regulated or externally reviewable cases (adds documented rationale, explicit evidence review, multiple-claim review, formal ownership and review cadence, written reassessment conditions).

name: State the claim and its posture
what_to_do: Write what is being acted on as true (Claim, Core concept) and whether it is in discovery, commitment or reassessment.

name: Evidence review
what_to_do: List evidence that supports or challenges the claim. For each item consider relevance, incentives of the source, proximity to the decision, verifiability.

name: Assumptions (explicit and shadow)
what_to_do: State what must be true for the claim to hold, including shadow (hidden) assumptions.
notes: 'dependencies' is not a named Clarity field; it is recorded here as part of 'what must be true'.

name: Confidence and proportional certainty
what_to_do: Judge whether confidence matches evidence strength (Confidence, Core) and whether certainty matches the consequence of being wrong (Proportional Certainty, Core).
notes: Clarity defines no confidence scale; this template uses EDF's qualitative labels (EDF-04) so confidence is not presented as a probability.

name: Ownership
what_to_do: Name who owns the claim and its consequences.

name: Decision posture (impact x correctability)
what_to_do: Rate impact if wrong (Low/Moderate/High/Critical) and correctability (Highly/Moderately/Low/Very low correctable; includes reversibility, recovery speed and cost, who bears consequences, mitigation). Select posture: Fast (low impact, reversible), Experimental (reversible but uncertain), Guardrail (high impact, operationally constrained, risk control), Strategic (high impact, hard to reverse).

name: Monitoring signals, thresholds, triggers
what_to_do: For each significant trigger define: monitoring signal; threshold; underlying trigger claim (Candidate concept); owner; operational response; reassessment response; trigger reassessment condition.

name: Reconsideration criteria
what_to_do: State current understanding, its justification, current mode/commitment, and 'I will reconsider if' conditions; monitor only those conditions.
notes: 'falsifying evidence' is the mission's term; it is mapped to Clarity reconsideration criteria.

name: Failure detection, boundaries and commitment outcome
what_to_do: Define observable failure signals; authority boundaries of the owner; and the commitment outcome: Commit, Continue Experiment, Delay or Escalate; plus review date/trigger.
notes: A decision record presumes a decision owner and a decision to be made now; for research assumptions only the analysis fields apply, not the commitment itself.

name: Failure-pattern check
what_to_do: Check for Confidence Debt (Core), Assumption Drift, Trigger Drift (Research), Resolution Debt, Governance Debt (Candidate), Burden Externalization (Candidate), Reassessment Failure.
notes: Candidate/Research concepts must be labelled as such (Constitution Art. III).

name: Result write-up
what_to_do: Executive Understanding; Clarity Snapshot; Current Understanding; Evidence Landscape; Assumption Landscape; Calibration Review; Correctability Review; Monitoring Plan; Reassessment Plan; Learning Priorities; Framework Concepts Observed; Recommended Next Posture; Current Best Understanding.
notes: Assessor guide: 'The goal is not to complete a worksheet.'

name: Optional experimental variant
what_to_do: Triage; bottom line with probability; evidence check (reliability, independence, primary vs claim; recompute numbers); strongest rival with discriminating evidence and causal checks (confounding, reverse causation, selection/survivorship, regression to mean); load-bearing assumptions marked fact/assumption; act or wait; reconsider-if with thresholds.
notes: Status EXPERIMENTAL, not production methodology. Used here only as the source for the 'alternative explanations' column (strongest rival).

name: Define System Context
what_to_do: Declare Primary System, Context, Focus. Analysis is valid only within it.
applicability_to_servicing_assumptions: applicable to adjacent observed outcomes only

name: Define the Outcome
what_to_do: State the outcome in factual, not interpretive, terms.
applicability_to_servicing_assumptions: NOT applicable to the nine assumptions: they are hypotheses about a business that does not exist, so no factual outcome exists. Applicable to observed market outcomes (e.g. RCF's payments to Ren; Ren's customer concentration; public-data exception rates).
notes: The 2026-11-14 mission guide adds the rule 'EDF is applied only to an observed outcome'; the spec's requirement that the outcome be factual implies the same limit.

name: Identify Manifestations
what_to_do: List observable signals of the outcome.

name: Build the Origin Network
what_to_do: Identify contributing origins (Technical, Human, Organizational, Environmental, Financial, Regulatory); prefer a network over a single root cause.

name: Trace Propagation
what_to_do: Describe paths (Physical, Informational, Organizational, Financial, Human) from origins to outcome.
notes: Nearest EDF analogue of the mission's 'causal mechanism' and 'feedback loops' columns; EDF defines no feedback-loop construct.

name: Evaluate Evidence
what_to_do: Separate direct observation from inference; grade quality; note gaps and disputes.

name: Identify Control Points
what_to_do: Where intervention could most influence future outcomes; may differ from origins.

name: Rank Control Points
what_to_do: Rank by Influence, Controllability, Cost, Confidence; defensible ordering without false precision.

name: Determine Diagnostic Sufficiency
what_to_do: 'Do we understand enough to take the next responsible action?'

name: Diagnostic Calibration
what_to_do: Separate analyses under same evidence; cross review; revision record; synthesis distinguishing scope vs interpretation differences. Convergence is not evidence of correctness.
applicability_to_servicing_assumptions: NOT applicable as evidence here: lenses produced by one model are not independent replications (diagnostic-calibration.md 'Evidence Boundary').

name: Label claims
what_to_do: Keep separate: structural conformity, semantic agreement, factual correctness, reproducibility, incremental value, utility. Claim states: internal-demonstration, suggestive, unsupported, contradicted, falsified, superseded, planned ('supported' without a boundary prohibited). Confidence: Low, Low-Medium, Medium, Medium-High, High (qualitative, not probability). Exact percentages only with raw inputs, denominator and scoring unit preserved.

name: Execution layer handshake
what_to_do: For each action record Owner, Plan, Priority, Verification; after execution return to EDF to check whether the intervention changed the manifestation.
